scope: Exact NOAA NSDE CMP project archive manifestations for the bounded 15-project Puerto Rico current shoreline source family
source_contract: frozen NSDE app.js constructs CMP downloads as https://nsde.ngs.noaa.gov/downloads/<feature.properties.id>.zip

member_inventory_summary.standard_three_family_projects: projbnd polygon + softcopyl1 polyline + softcopyp1 point

adjudication.prior_guessed_distribution: SUPERSEDED downstream conclusion only: the earlier guessed geodesy.noaa.gov/dist_shoreline paths returned non-ZIP error payloads; those source responses remain preserved.
adjudication.exact_distribution: PASS; all 15 UI-derived NSDE /downloads/<id>.zip manifestations are valid ZIP archives.
adjudication.project_boundary: projbnd is project scope only and must never be used as land/insular identity geometry.
adjudication.line_geometry: softcopyl1/PR2401 l1 are multi-class cartographic line datasets; only records explicitly classified by NOAA as CLASS=SHORELINE may enter shoreline derivation.
adjudication.identity: NOAA archive membership, project coverage, shoreline containment and representative-point proximity do not independently establish canonical insular identity.
